instruction.text: Draw a line between Southampton and New York to find out how tourists travelled overseas in the first half of the 1900s.

feedback.end: To reach places overseas, British tourists set out on passenger ships from ports such as Southampton. However, these journeys could only be afforded by the rich.

atoms.a: What do you think allowed more British people to go on holiday in other countries?

feedback.end: In the second half of the 1900s, advancements in transport, such as aeroplanes, meant that British people gradually spent more time holidaying abroad than at home.

instruction.text: Listen and read along to this letter in the newspaper. Does the writer prefer holidays at home or abroad?

atoms.a: I cannot understand why British people go abroad for their holidays. If they want lovely scenery, they have it in England, Scotland, Wales and Ireland.

feedback.end: Not everybody was impressed with the trend of travelling abroad. Many preferred to stay at seaside resorts and holiday camps in Britain, which could also be more affordable.

instruction.text: Find and select Spain on the map of Europe.

feedback.end: Despite some people preferring to stay at home, over a third of all British tourists chose to holiday in Spain by the 1970s. Travel companies offered cheap package holidays for around half a month’s average wage.

instruction.text: Find and select the travel agency on the high street.

feedback.end: When people booked their holidays abroad, they often went to a travel agency on their local high street. Travel agencies help with organising transport, hotels and activities, and are still popular today.

instruction.text: This woman is speaking with a travel agent to book a holiday abroad. Fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: Hello, I would like to ((++travel dance)) abroad this summer and stay somewhere hot in Europe.
Excellent! We currently have a deal available for a package ((++holiday delivery)) in the Canary Islands.
That sounds great, what is included in the ((++package box))?
The price will cover your flights and ((++hotel electricity)), which is full board. That means breakfast, lunch and dinner are included.
I’d also be interested in doing some outdoor ((++activities actives)) while I’m there.
You can add a boat trip as an extra. There is also a group ((++hiking singing)) tour along the coast.
I will book the hike, ((++thank_you sorry))!
